{{Quote|If you can't walk away from a fight, take control of it. Force the enemy to engage you on your terms, for a rash attack is an unbalanced attack, and thus the outcome of a battle may be decided before the first blow is struck. But don't forget&mdash;the Force is a powerful ally.|The Jedi, to Dass Jennir|<ref name="BH Pt 2" />}}
A '''individual''' served as [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Old Jedi Order]], and was the Jedi master of [[Dass Jennir]]. After the execution of [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]], and while [[Unarmed combat/Legends|fighting]] a [[Chistori]] [[Unidentified Chistori thug|thug]] and [[Gender/Legends|his]] allies, Jennir recalled something his master had once told him [[Standard year/Legends|years]] prior.<ref name="BH Pt 2" />
